subject: The usage (--help) message now refers to valkey (#189)
reason: The change rewrites only the fprintf string literals in usage() in src/server.c (the text shown for valkey-server -h/--help or bad arguments) and nothing else: no parsing, reply, persistence, replication, or startup behaviour changes, and the function still just prints to stderr and exits 1. The fuzzer's components cannot reach it anyway: valkey.action.tools runs only valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb and valkey-check-aof, not valkey-server itself, and every other component starts valkey-server with a valid config, which never invokes usage().
